name: guz
description: Declares and tracks a repo's architecture-and-style contract in a checked-in .guz.yaml: chosen patterns and style rules with declared priority, modules, and scores filled in later by audit, then works the findings the audit leaves behind.

review_before_commit.title: Wait for your review before each commit
review_before_commit.description: When on, Claude stops after each finished module, asks you to review the code, and commits only after you say so. When off, Claude commits on its own as before.
